scaleProfile._about: SOBEKTUNE v1: Sobek's foot is 1.83x the Joan foot (Foot->ToeBase 0.309 / 0.169 m, measure_scale.py). The Joan-scale G-plant limit footFloorMaxM is multiplied by this for Sobek only. Not a waiver: the roll still has to stay within 0.05 x 1.83 m, and its hips are lifted (hipsYOffsetM) so the toes stop sinking.
